def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}

from collections import defaultdict
def deg(cells, diag):
    cells=set(cells); d={}
    for i,j in cells:
        n=0
        for di in range(-1,2):
            for dj in range(-1,2):
                if di==dj==0: continue
                if not diag and abs(di)+abs(dj)!=1: continue
                if (i+di,j+dj) in cells: n+=1
        d[(i,j)]=n
    return d
